name: Titanium.UI.iOS.SnapBehavior
summary: Dynamic behavior defining an item's movement to a specific point.
description:
A snap behavior specifies how an item moves towards a specified point with a spring-like
effect, ending with an oscillation.

  1. Use the [Titanium.UI.iOS.createSnapBehavior](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#createSnapBehavior) method to create the behavior.
  2. Set the [item](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.SnapBehavior#item) and
     [snapPoint](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.SnapBehavior#snapPoint) properties.
  3. Add the behavior to an [Animator object](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.Animator).

examples.title: Simple Example

properties.name: damping
properties.summary: Specifies the amount of oscillation during the conclusion of the snap.
properties.description: A value of 0.0 indicates minimum oscillation, while 1.0 indicates maximum oscillation.

properties.name: item
properties.summary: Item to add to this behavior.

properties.name: snapPoint
properties.summary: Specifies the point to snap to.
properties.description: The coordinate system depends on the animator's reference view.
